title: Relative flatness from stalks
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Suppose for every $x\in X$ the stalk $G_x$ [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], with scalar action through $f^\sharp_x$, is flat over $\mathcal O_{S,f(x)}$. Then $G$ satisfies the affine-section relative-flatness condition [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over].

source.place: Morphisms, lemma-flat-module, implication (1) to (2); Algebra Tag 00HT, local criterion for flatness

proof.text: Fix affine V and U with U contained in f inverse V. Let R=O(V), A=O(U), N=G(U), restricting N along f.appLE. For each maximal ideal q of A, choose x using isoSpec.inv; isoSpec.inv_hom_id identifies its primeIdealOf with q. The source stalk is the localization of A at q. Rewrite the equal-open identity appLE to the identity map and obtain E: O_x tensor_A N is O_x-linearly equivalent to G_x from affine_sections_stalk_tensor_presentation. Restrict E to A and compose with m -> 1 tensor m. IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv transports the canonical localization map of the tensor product, giving the localization data required by flat_of_isLocalized_maximal.

For each maximal q, put B=O_S(f(x)). The hypothesis makes G_x B-flat. The base affine stalk localization makes B R-flat. The formula f.germ_stalkMap_apply followed by germ_res_apply proves that the R-action via R -> A -> O_x agrees with restriction along R -> B -> O_x. This gives IsScalarTower R B G_x explicitly. Module.Flat.trans now makes G_x R-flat.

Apply Module.flat_of_isLocalized_maximal with R, A, N, the stalk modules at the points of maximal ideals, and the constructed localization maps. This gives the required R-flatness of N for the affine-pair test. Repeat for every V,U. Empty affine opens have no maximal ideals and zero sections, included in the local criterion.

lean.statement:
theorem relative_flat_of_stalks {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (G : X.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (h : ∀ x : X, Module.Flat (S.presheaf.stalk (f x))
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap x).hom).obj
        ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj G))) :
    G.IsFlatOver f
